item.title: Extremely Wide confidence intervals
item.description: Hey guys! Hope you all have a blessed week. I’ve been running some logistic and multinomial regressions in R, trying to analyse a survey I conducted a few months back. Unfortunately I ran into a problem. In multiple regressions (mainly multinomials), ORs as well as CIs are extremely wide, and some range from 0 to inf. How should I proceed? I feel kinda stucked. Is there any way to check for multicollinearity or perfect separation in multinomial regressions? Results from the questionnaire seemed fine, with adequate respondents in each category. Any insight would be of great assistance!!! Thank you in advance. Have a great end of the week.
